outcomes.name: Semantic routing to a route card
outcomes.statement: Given a free-text task, the system selects exactly one of 11 job-type route cards (or a safe bootstrap default) and returns the required context, skills, work loop, artifacts, proof, and next action.

outcomes.name: Harness structural-contract validation
outcomes.statement: The system fails locally and in CI if any required harness artifact, route card, skill, memory file, playbook, eval, hook, or BAML contract is missing, malformed, or too thin.

outcomes.reviewer_notes: Validation is structural (presence + phrase counts); does not verify semantic correctness beyond scripted route cases.

outcomes.name: Proof-before-completion gate
outcomes.statement: The system prevents an agent from claiming a task complete unless the route's proof commands have run and passed (or skipped checks are justified).
outcomes.settlement_criterion: A completion claim without recorded passing verification is rejected or flagged operator-visibly before the final response

declared_evidence.note: Completion theater is a blocking defect
controls MUST be attached to executable behavior; SHOULD NOT exist as advice

implementation_evidence.note: classifies missing/partial/verified but does not block
stamps completion_claim unconditionally; does NOT check proof passed

outcomes.runtime_path: trace finish -> trace_finish stamps claim -> later distill classifies status (after the fact)

gaps.description: no code path rejects trace_finish or blocks turn.stop when verification is absent/failing
spec says controls SHOULD NOT exist as advice; the only turn.stop impl is advisory text
no negative test that a claim without proof is rejected

outcomes.reviewer_notes: Highest-leverage gap. Decide whether blocking is delegated to host agent native hooks (document the boundary) or implemented in trace_finish/a new gate.

outcomes.name: EvalSpec execution (static checks)
